record.title: microduck-bottom-head-shell
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares two MEASURED anchors — 'head_shell_screws' (3 x Ø2.6950 x 2.0040 on a Ø112.1175 circle at (0.0000, 49.5000) and (+-39.0000, -49.5000), the two front positions adding a Ø6.9020 x 3.1450 boss with a Ø5.5000 x 2.8240 driver bore, and the same three (x, y) carry part:microduck-top-head-shell's Ø2.1000 pilots measured independently on the other mesh) and 'motor_support_screws' (4 x Ø2.2000 x 9.3000 pilots with Ø2.7900 x 0.7010 counterbores at exactly the four (x, y) of part:microduck-motor-support's own Ø2.7000 through-holes, again measured independently) — frozen in out/laneT/features/bottom_head_shell.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON and builds no geometry. And this part sits under COMPARISON.html finding 1: its mate, top_head_shell, measures 122.6900 mm front-to-back against the compact domed head in every product photograph, so the head pair may be replaced wholesale. What settles it: lane A's head reconstruction, then a loader or graded rebuild here. 2026-09-03 (lane A, tools/head_frontfit.py): FAIL against the product photographs on ONE measured feature. In the true front view the accent trim band at the head's split line is 0.9666 ± 0.0090 of the head's own widest row on the product and 1.0000 of it on this mesh set — −3.069 ± 0.831 mm at the mesh width, 3.7σ, and still FAIL under the reading in which only the jaw is accent-coloured (−2.601 mm). On the product the top shell overhangs this band by about 1.53 mm per side (confirmed at 8× on both edges, out/head/front_edges.png); on the mesh top_head_shell 91.760, bottom_head_shell 91.763 and jaw 91.416 mm are flush to 0.35 mm. The head's overall WIDTH is 89.386 ± 1.815 mm against this mesh's 91.763 — CANNOT DETERMINE at the 1.5 mm rule, so the shell is NOT rescaled: where a width change comes out of the section is not measurable from photographs, and a lateral scale would move part:microduck-jaw's mouth_horn 1.26 mm off the XL330 horn that does not scale. What settles it: a calliper across one product head.
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
